title: Cobb-Douglas Production Function Optimization
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Maximize production P(L, K) = 50 L^(0.5) K^(0.5) subject to budget constraint 100 L + 200 K = 40000.

steps.title: Set Up Lagrange Ratio of Marginal Productivities
steps.mathExpression: \frac{\partial P / \partial L}{100} = \frac{\partial P / \partial K}{200} \implies \frac{25 L^{-0.5} K^{0.5}}{100} = \frac{25 L^{0.5} K^{-0.5}}{200} \implies \frac{K}{100 L} = \frac{1}{200} \implies L = 2K
steps.explanation: Equating marginal product per dollar yields capital-labor expansion path L = 2K.

steps.title: Compute Maximum Production
steps.explanation: Substitute optimal L and K into production function.
